(Non-spoiler Review) Persona 5 is a REALLY great game before I say anything else but this is my review. (This is comparing to P3R and P4G) Persona 5 has some of the best gameplay and things to choose from, especially with it's place in Tokyo. But it is LACKING in half of the social links, for example Ohya, Haru, etc. just being straight up boring and sleep worthy, Some of the game isn't really fun with the social link atmosphere. ALTHOUGH, some of the social links are GREAT like Ryuji, Maruki, Makoto, etc. Now the biggest thing is the slow pacing, this definitely has the worst pacing out of the 3 Modernsonas. Otherwise, this game is AWESOME AND I HIGHLY RECCOMEND IT FOR ANY NEW PERSONA PLAYERS! (PS: Persona 4 Golden is the best persona Game👀)

If you're looking for a game that delivers absolute peak, let me tell you one thing: THIS IS THAT GAME!

I thought I had played some real masterpieces before picking up this game, only for Persona 5 Royal to show me what true peak really looks like.

After experiencing my first Persona game just a couple of months ago, I honestly didn't think things could get any better. However, somehow, Persona 5 Royal blew my expectations out of the water tenfold. In simple words, this game is truly perfect.

I love everything about this game, maybe even a little too much, because by the end, I was genuinely sad to say goodbye to this game and its world.

So, if you're looking to truly experience peak storytelling, I would highly recommend playing Persona 5 Royal!

This game has earned a 10/10!
